{{Quote|Xendor died at Columus, as the Jedi and the armies they'd beguiled closed in.|[[Arden Lyn]]|<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Columus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds's]] [[Columus system/Legends|Columus system]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. A low-gravity, geologically-stable planet, Columus lacked any geographic features and possessed a shallow soil layer, causing its native plants to form horizontal root systems. The Columi species evolved to [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] remarkably early in the history of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], achieving interstellar travel by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 BBY]]. However, the Columi were disappointed by their failure to contact any other species with intelligence on par with their own, and they retreated to Columus and remained in isolation on their homeworld. Around [[24,500 BBY]], during the [[First Great Schism]], Columus was the site of the pivotal [[Battle of Columus]] between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Legions of Lettow]], a battle in which the Legions' leader [[General/Legends|General]] [[Xendor]] was [[Death/Legends|slain]]. Columus later joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its successor state the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], though the Columi's decision to join the Empire was motivated by a desire to maintain their isolation.

==Description==
[[File:Columi_GG4.png|thumb|left|100px|A Columi]]
Columus was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Columus system/Legends|Columus system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Atlas" /> and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. A planet with extremely low gravity, Columus was geologically stable&mdash;a property that prevented the formation of mountains, rifts, or other similar geographic features, and gave the planet a low [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] pressure. As a result, Columus was a flat, muddy planet with weak winds and a shallow soil layer. Because of the lack of erosion, water settled into the soil, though the bedrock of the planet had relatively few cracks. Despite this, the plant life of Columus developed in an immense variety. The planet's larger plants and trees developed root systems that extended horizontally through the soil, covering wide areas and providing themselves a solid support structure. Columus was covered by swamps and forests, and the [[City/Legends|cities]] of the Columi,<ref name="Guide 4" /> among them [[Bailee]],<ref name="Holonet" /> rose above the treetops on pylons and were dependent on heavily automated factories.<ref name="Guide 4" />

==History==
{{Quote|At Columus, Pina's armies cut off Xendor and his vanguard from the bulk of his forces, and Pina's Jedi Knights advanced on my love as one.|Arden Lyn|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 BBY]], a species of four-legged herbivorous lizards with a buoyant belly evolved to walk on their hind legs on Columus. A few thousand years later, those herbivores began to lay their eggs in trees in order to protect them from predators, and the Columi began to live entirely in trees shortly afterward. They developed hands instead of claws and a prehenisle tail, and they soon learned to use tools after only a few centuries. The Columi underwent a series of rapid evolutionary changes over the next few thousand years, losing their tails and becoming truly [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], and they began to mine metals and other materials so they could build cities, becoming a technological civilization. Over the next several thousand years, the Columi advanced their technology to the point where they were capable of interstellar travel<ref name="Guide 4" /> by the year 100,000 BBY. Shortly afterwards, the Columi visited a number of planets&mdash;including [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], the homes of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] species, but they returned to Columus in disappointment because they considered the species they had encountered to be too primitive.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The Columi soon gave up interstellar travel and remained on Columus, content to remain in isolation.<ref name="Guide 4" />

[[File:BattleOfColumus-BoS.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Battle of Columus]]
Around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], Human scientists from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] developed the modern [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], linking Corellia, Coruscant, [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Columus, and many other Core Worlds together.<ref name="Atlas" /> Around [[24,500 BBY]], Columus was the site of the [[Battle of Columus]] during the [[First Great Schism]] between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Legions of Lettow]], a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. Nearly thirty Dark Jedi, including the Legion's leader, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Xendor]], attempted to trap a number of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in one of Columus' rare ravines, and both groups annihilated each other<ref name="Jedi">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>&mdash;though the Jedi [[Awdrysta Pina]] escaped after killing Xendor,<ref name="Warfare" /> the only other survivor, a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Danzigorro Potts]], recorded his thoughts on the battle in what later became known as the [[Columus Data Card]] before he died on the plains of Columus.<ref name="Jedi" />

Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Columus Tourist Board]] started a marketing campaign that extolled the health benefits of Columus' low-gravity environment to severely overweight beings. However, a number of health officials, including [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gidoo Zehow]] of the [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] [[Rhinnal State Medical Academy|State Medical Academy]], criticized the campaign and presented evidence that their claims were false.<ref name="Holonet" /> Columus was one of four planets, with the others being [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]], [[Lur]], and [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]], that were exempt from [[Decree E49D139.41]], which prohibited all non-military [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] of sentients during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]; Columus was permitted to continue therapeutic medical cloning with the appropriate license.<ref name="RC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] replaced the Republic as the primary government in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the Columi quickly passed a resolution to enter the Empire in order to maintain their isolation, though some Columi departed their homeworld to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] or to become criminals. The Imperial [[sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]] claimed in his ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]'' that the Empire had made first contact with the Columi on Columus, as he did with the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] species of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="Guide 4" /> In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] attacked the New Republic as part of an [[Imperial Skirmishes|campaign]] by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. However, her forces were routed by the [[New Republic Fourth Fleet|New Republic Fourth Battle Group]] under [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]. Daala [[Battle of Columus (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] Bel Iblis at Columus, though her forces were routed again and her [[Scylla (frigate)|own warship]] forced into a blind [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Inhabitants==
The primary inhabitants of Columus were the Columi, who ruled their homeworld in a participatory democracy&mdash;every Columi had an equal voting share in the Columi government. The Columi lived in their extensive cities atop pylons in the forests of Columus.<ref name="Guide 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' mistakenly labels an image of the Battle of Columus as [[Corbos]], which was the site of a [[Battle of Corbos|battle]] in the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]].
